monster:tob2:chill-haunt.damageResistances: acid, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster:tob2:chill-haunt.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Cryophobia
traits.description: Whenever the chill haunt is subjected to cold damage, it takes no damage, but it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of the source of the damage for 1 minute. This trait overrides the haunt’s normal immunity to the frightened condition.

traits.name: Fire Absorption
traits.description: Whenever the chill haunt is subjected to fire damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hp equal to the fire damage dealt.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The chill haunt can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Shivering Touch
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) cold damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or take 3 (1d6) cold damage at the start of each of its turns. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If the target takes fire damage, the effect ends.

monster:a5e-mm:chimera.speed: 30 ft., Climb 15 ft., Fly 60 ft., Swim 15 ft.

traits.name: Reactive Heads
traits.description: The chimera can take three reactions per round, but not more than one per turn.

traits.name: Three Heads
traits.description: The chimera has advantage on Perception checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious, and it can't be flanked.

traits.name: Wakeful
traits.description: When one of the chimeras heads is asleep, the others are awake.

actions.name: Headbutt
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or fall prone.

actions.name: Breath Weapon
actions.description: The dragon head breathes fire in a 15-foot cone. Creatures in the area make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw  taking 21 (6d6) fire damage on a failed save or half damage on a success.

reactions.name: Tail Swipe
reactions.description: If a creature within 5 feet hits the chimera with a melee attack, the attacker is battered by the chimeras tail. The attacker makes a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failure, it takes 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage and is pushed 10 feet from the chimera and knocked prone.

reactions.name: Winged Charge
reactions.description: If a creature the chimera can see hits it with a ranged attack, the chimera leaps off the ground and moves up to its fly speed towards the attacker. If within range, the chimera then makes a headbutt attack against the attacker.

legendaryActions.name: The chimera can take 2 legendary actions
legendaryActions.description: Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creatures turn. It regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendaryActions.name: Bite
legendaryActions.description: The chimera uses its Bite attack.

legendaryActions.name: Claw
legendaryActions.description: The chimera uses its Claw attack.

monster:bfrd:chimera.speed: 30 ft., Climb 15 ft., Fly 60 ft., Swim 15 ft.

traits.name: Bickering Heads
traits.description: The chimera is perpetually one step away from arguing with itself. A creature that can see the chimera can use a bonus action on its turn to appeal to one of the chimera's heads with bribes (dragon), praise (lion), displays of magic (goat), or other clever manipulation of a head's desires. The chimera must succeed on a DC 15 WIS save or succumb to that desire.If the lion or goat head succumbs, the chimera has disadvantage on the next Bite or Headbutt attack it makes before the end of its next turn. If the dragon head succumbs, creatures caught in the chimera's next Fire Breath have advantage on the save, provided the chimera uses the breath within the next 1 minute. Once a head has succumbed to a desire, that head can't succumb again for the next 24 hours.

traits.name: Monstrosity Resilience
traits.description: The chimera is resistant to exhaustion and to the frightened condition.

traits.name: Multiple Heads
traits.description: The chimera has three heads and is resistant to the blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and unconscious conditions.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The chimera makes one Bite attack, one Headbutt attack, and two Claws attacks, or it can make two Claws attacks and use Fire Breath, if available.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8+4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Headbutt
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d12+4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath
actions.description: The dragon head exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 DEX save, taking 27 (6d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monster:tob3:chimera-royal.speed: 40 ft., Climb 20 ft., Fly 80 ft., Swim 20 ft.
monster:tob3:chimera-royal.senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 16

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: Choose to succeed failed save.

traits.name: Regal Bearing
traits.description: The chimera’s AC includes its Cha modifier.

legendaryActions.name: Prideful Prowl
legendaryActions.description: Moves up to its walking speed or flies up to half its flying speed with o provoking opportunity attacks.

legendaryActions.name: Serpent Strike
legendaryActions.description: Makes one Serpent Strike attack.

legendaryActions.name: Cast a Spell
legendaryActions.description: Uses Spellcasting.

legendaryActions.name: Roar of the King
legendaryActions.description: Lion head's bellow spurs allies. Each friendly creature including chimera within 30' of it that can hear roar gains 11 (2d10) temp hp and can't be frightened for 1 min.

monster:tob2:chimeric-phantom.languages: any languages its constituent souls knew in life
monster:tob2:chimeric-phantom.damageResistances: acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster:tob2:chimeric-phantom.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Frightening Madness
traits.description: A chimeric phantom’s madness unnerves those nearby. Any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the chimeric phantom must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the start of its next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the chimeric phantom’s Frightening Madness for 24 hours.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The chimeric phantom can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The chimeric phantom makes two Maddening Grasp attacks.

actions.name: Maddening Grasp
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) necrotic damage.

monster:tob:chort-devil.languages: Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal, Primordial; telepathy (120 ft.)
monster:tob:chort-devil.damageResistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with silvered weapons

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.description: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description:
the chort devil's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). The chort devil can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

at will: blur, magic circle, teleport

3/day: scorching ray (5 rays)

1/day each: dispel magic, dominate person, flame strike, haste

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The chort devil makes three melee attacks with its flaming ranseur, or three melee attacks with its claws.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d4 + 7) slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Charisma damage.

actions.name: Flaming Ranseur
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (1d10 + 7) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Devilish Weapons
actions.description: Any weapons wielded by a chort devil do 10 (3d6) fire damage in addition to their normal weapon damage.

monster:tob-2023:chort-devil.damageResistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with silvered weapons

traits.name: Devil’s Sight
traits.description: Magical darkness doesn’t impede the chort devil’s darkvision.

traits.name: Hellish Weapons
traits.description: The chort devil’s weapon attacks are magical. When the devil hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 4d6 fire damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The chort devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The chort devil makes one Claw attack and two Ranseur attacks, or it makes four Hurl Flame attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d4 + 7) slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) fire damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or have disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws that use Charisma for 1 hour or until cured by a lesser restoration spell or similar magic.

actions.name: Ranseur
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (1d10 + 7) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Hurl Flame
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +9 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (4d6 + 5) fire damage.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.description: The chort devil magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The chort devil casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

- At Will: charm person, illusory script (as an action)
- 3/Day Each: dispel magic, modify memory
1/day: haste

traits.name: Mirror Scales
traits.description: While the chroma lizard is in bright light creatures that rely on sight have disadvantage on attack rolls vs. the lizard.

traits.name: Mirror Shy
traits.description: If the chroma lizard sees itself reflected in a polished surface within 30' of it and in an area of bright light the lizard immediately closes its eyes and is blinded until the start of its next turn when it can check for the reflection again.

traits.name: Radiant Reflection
traits.description: When a creature deals radiant to the chroma lizard half the radiant the lizard took is reflected back at that creature.

monster:tob:chronalmental.damageImmunities: poison; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Temporal Body
traits.description: When a chronalmental is subjected to a slow spell, haste spell, or similar effect, it automatically succeeds on the saving throw and regains 13 (3d8) hit points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The chronalmental makes 1d4 + 1 slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Steal Time
actions.description: The chronalmental targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The targeted creature must make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed saving throw, the chronalmental draws some of the creature's time into itself and gains +10 to its position in initiative order. In addition, the target's speed is reduced by half, it can't take reactions, and it can take either an action or a bonus action on its turn, but not both. While it is stealing time, the chronalmental's speed increases by 30 feet, and when it takes the multiattack action, it can make an additional slam attack. The targeted creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Displace
actions.description: The chronalmental targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be magically shunted outside of time. The creature disappears for 1 minute. As an action, the displaced creature can repeat the saving throw. On a success, the target returns to its previously occupied space, or the nearest unoccupied space.

reactions.name: Step Between Seconds
reactions.description: When a creature the chronalmental can see moves within 5 feet of it, the chronalmental can shift itself to a place it occupied in the past, teleporting up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying.

monster:tob-2023:chronalmental.damageImmunities: poison; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster:tob-2023:chronalmental.conditionImmunities: exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, restrained, unconscious

traits.name: Elemental Nature
traits.description: The chronalmental doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Temporal Body
traits.description: When a chronalmental is subjected to a slow spell, haste spell, or similar effect, it automatically succeeds on any saving throws required by the spell or effect and regains 13 (3d8) hp.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The chronalmental makes three Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Steal Time
actions.description: The chronalmental steals time from one creature it can see within 30 feet of it, drawing the stolen time into itself. The target must make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the target's speed is halved, and it can take either an action or a bonus action on its turn, but not both for 1 minute. Then, the chronalmental's position in the initiative order increases by 10, its speed increases by 30 feet, and when it takes the Multiattack action, it can make one additional Slam attack. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effects on itself and the chronalmental on a success.

actions.name: Displace
actions.description: The chronalmental sends one creature it can see within 30 feet of it outside of the flow of time, shunting the creature to a tiny demiplane. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned and magically shunted outside of time for 1 minute. The creature disappears for the duration, returning to the space it previously occupied, or the nearest unoccupied space, when the effect ends. At the end of each of its turns, the target can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

reactions.name: Step Between Seconds
reactions.description: When a creature the chronalmental can see moves within 5 feet of it, the chronalmental can teleport, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, to an unoccupied space within 60 feet that it occupied within the past minute.

monster:tob2:chronomatic-enhancer.senses: darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 10 ft., passive Perception 16
monster:tob2:chronomatic-enhancer.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak
monster:tob2:chronomatic-enhancer.damageResistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with adamantine weapons
monster:tob2:chronomatic-enhancer.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Delay
traits.description: When damage is dealt to the chronomatic enhancer, the enhancer doesn’t take the damage until its next turn. The enhancer must still make the appropriate saving throws, and it immediately suffers any extra effects of the damage, such as the speed-reducing effect of the ray of frost spell. Only the damage is delayed.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.description: The chronomatic enhancer is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The chronomatic enhancer can use its Time-Infused Gears. It then makes three slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Time-Infused Gears
actions.description:
The chronomatic enhancer spins its time-infused gears, altering time near it. It can't affect itself with its gears. When activating its time-infused gears, it uses one of the following:
 Energizing Electricity. The chronomatic enhancer releases mild electricity into up to three creatures the enhancer can see within 30 feet of it. Each target has its speed doubled, it gains a +2 bonus to its AC, it has advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and it gains an additional bonus action or reaction (target's choice) until the end of its next turn.
 Slowing Gas. The chronomatic enhancer releases a slowing gas, affecting up to three creatures it can see within 20 feet of it. Each target must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature can't use reactions, its speed is halved, and it can't make more than one attack on its turn. In addition, the target can use either an action or a bonus action on its turn, but not both. These effects last until the end of the target's next turn.
 Stasis (Recharge 6). The chronomatic enhancer stops time for up to three creatures it can see within 30 feet of it. Each target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be frozen in time until the end of its next turn. A creature frozen in time is treated as if it is petrified, except it isn't transformed into an inanimate substance and its weight doesn't increase.

reactions.name: Alter Timeline
reactions.description: When a friendly creature within 15 feet of the chronomatic enhancer takes damage, the enhancer can modify time to protect the creature, changing all damage dice rolled to 1s.

traits.name: Feybane
traits.description: Creatures of the fey type don't recover spells during a long rest while within 60 feet of the chuhaister. In addition, the chuhaister automatically sees through magical illusions created by spells of 3rd level or lower and has advantage on saving throws and ability checks to detect or see through illusion spells of 4th level or higher.

traits.name: Light Sensitivity
traits.description: While in bright light, the chuhaister has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The chuhaister makes two greatclub attacks.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (5d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 33 (5d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Deadfall Shield
reactions.description: When the chuhaister or one ally within 30 feet of it is hit by an attack, the chuhaister can create a magical, wooden barrier that interrupts the attack. The attack causes no damage. The shield splinters and disappears afterwards.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.description: The chupacabra has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: Running Leap
traits.description: With a 10-foot running start, the chupacabra can long jump up to 25 feet.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, and the chupacabra attaches to the target. While attached, the chupacabra doesn't attack. Instead, at the start of each of the chupacabra's turns, the target loses 6 (1d6 + 3) hp due to blood loss. The chupacabra can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. It does so after the target is reduced to 0 hp. A creature, including the target, can use its action to detach the chupacabra.

actions.name: Fearful Gaze
actions.description: The chupacabra fixes its gaze on one creature it can see within 10 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. A paralyzed creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the chupacabra's Fearful Gaze for the next 24 hours.

reactions.name: Malodorous Stench
reactions.description: When the chupacabra is reduced to less than half of its maximum hp, it releases a foul, sulphurous stench. Each creature within 5 feet of the chupacabra must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

monster:a5e-mm:chuul.languages: understands Deep Speech but can't speak

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The chuul can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Detect Magic
traits.description: The chuul senses a magical aura around any visible creature or object within 120 feet that bears magic.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: If the chuul is grappling a creature  it uses its tentacle on that creature. It then makes two pincer attacks.

actions.name: Pincer
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature  it is grappled (escape DC 15). When carrying a grappled creature  the chuul can move at full speed. A pincer that is being used to grapple a creature can be used only to attack that creature.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.description: A grappled creature makes a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  it is paralyzed for 1 minute. The creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns  ending the paralysis on a success.

monster:bfrd:chuul.languages: understands Deep Speech but can't speak

traits.name: Aberrant Resilience
traits.description: The chuul is resistant to the charmed, frightened, paralyzed, and stunned conditions, and it has advantage on saves against spells or effects that would alter its form.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The chuul can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Sense Magic
traits.description: The chuul senses and can pinpoint the location of magic within 120 feet of it. If it senses magic and can see the creature or object bearing the magic it senses, it sees a faint aura around that creature or object.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The chuul makes two Pincer attacks.

actions.name: Pincer
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8+4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 14). The chuul has two pincers, each of which can grapple only one target.

actions.name: Wild Reach
actions.description: The chuul taps into ancient memories of magic and reaches toward nearby magic with an unpracticed grasp, releasing a burst of energy. Each creature within 15 feet of the chuul must make a DC 14 DEX save, taking 21 (6d6) damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If a magic item, spell effect, or spellcaster is within 30 feet of the chuul, the burst is pure arcane energy, dealing force damage. If no magic is within 30 feet of the chuul, the burst pulls from the chuul's own life force, dealing necrotic damage. If the damage is necrotic, the chuul takes necrotic damage as if it succeeded on the save.

bonusActions.name: Paralyzing Tentacles
bonusActions.description: One creature grappled by the chuul must succeed on a DC 14 CON save or be poisoned for 1 minute. Until this poison ends, the creature is paralyzed. A poisoned creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

monster:tob:cikavak.speed: 10 ft., Climb 5 ft., Fly 40 ft., Swim 5 ft.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description:
the cikavak's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 11). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

at will: speak with animals

1/day: silence

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

monster:tob-2023:cikavak.speed: 40 ft., Climb 20 ft., Fly 10 ft., Swim 20 ft.

traits.name: Limited Telepathy
traits.description: The cikavak can magically communicate simple ideas, emotions, and images telepathically with any creature that touches it and that can understand a language.

traits.name: Speak with Beasts
traits.description: The cikavak can communicate with Beasts as if they shared a language.

actions.name: Beak
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Silencing Squawk
actions.description: The cikavak lets out a magical squawk in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be deafened and unable to speak for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The cipactli can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Underwater Camouflage
traits.description: The cipactli has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made while underwater.

traits.name: Water Step
traits.description: As a bonus action, the cipactli can liquefy itself, disappearing from its current location and reappearing in an unoccupied space it can see within 20 feet. Its current location and the new location must be connected by water in some way: a stream, ooze, soggy ground, or even runoff from a drain pipe.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The cipactli makes two bite attacks. If both attacks hit a Medium or smaller target, the target is grappled (escape DC 14), and the cipactli uses its Devouring Embrace.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Devouring Embrace
actions.description:
The cipactli devours a Medium or smaller creature grappled by it. The devoured target is blinded, restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the cipactli, and it takes 14 (4d6) piercing damage at the start of each of the cipactli's turns as the fiend's lesser mouths slowly consume it.

If the cipactli moves, the devoured target moves with it. The cipactli can only devour one target at a time. A creature, including the devoured target, can take its action to pry the devoured target out of the cipactli's many jaws by succeeding on a DC 14 Strength check.

actions.name: Ancient Lullaby
actions.description: A cipactli sings a soporific, primordial song of eternal rest and divine repose from its many mouths. Each creature within 100 feet of the cipactli that can hear the song must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or fall asleep and remain unconscious for 10 minutes. A creature awakens if it takes damage or another creature takes an action to wake it. This song has no effect on constructs and undead.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the citrullus remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal melon plant.

traits.name: Gush
traits.description: When the citrullus takes bludgeoning damage, sticky juice splashes out of it. If the attacker is within 30 feet of the citrullus, the attacker must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained by the sticky juice as if it had failed a saving throw against the plant’s Bile Spray action.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Bile Spray
actions.description: The citrullus exhales pink bile in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 14 (4d6) acid damage and is restrained by the sticky seed-filled juice for 1 minute. On a success, the creature takes half the damage and isn't restrained. A creature, including the restrained creature, can take its action to free the restrained creature by succeeding on a DC 13 Strength check.

bonusActions.name: Creeping Seedlings
bonusActions.description: The seeds in the sticky juice grow viny tendrils and drag each creature restrained by Bile Spray and Gush up to 25 feet straight toward the citrullus.

traits.name: Tactical Insight
traits.description: The city watch captain has advantage on initiative rolls. City watch soldiers under the captain's command take their turns on the same initiative count as the captain.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The city watch captain makes two rapier attacks and one dagger attack. The captain can substitute a disarming attack for one rapier attack.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Disarming Attack
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: the target must make a successful DC 13 Strength saving throw or drop one item it's holding of the city watch captain's choice. The item lands up to 10 feet from the target, in a spot selected by the captain.

actions.name: Orders to Attack
actions.description: Each creature of the city watch captain's choice that is within 30 feet of it and can hear it makes one melee or ranged weapon attack as a reaction. This person could easily have been on the other side of the law, but he likes the way he looks in the city watch uniform-and the way city residents look at him when he walks down the street leading a patrol. With a long mustache and a jaunty cap, there's no denying that he cuts a rakishly handsome figure. While a trained investigator, the city watch captain is not afraid to draw his blade to end a threat to his city.

traits.name: Point Blank Fencer
traits.description: A rapier deals one extra die of its damage when the city watch captain hits with it (included in the attack). In addition, the captain ignores the loading property of crossbows and doesn’t have disadvantage on the attack roll with a crossbow from being within 5 feet of a hostile creature. The captain may still have disadvantage on such an attack from other sources.

traits.name: Tactical Insight
traits.description: The city watch captain has advantage on initiative rolls, and friendly creatures within 30 feet of the captain and under the captain’s command can choose to take the captain’s initiative instead of their own when combat starts.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The city watch captain can use its Issue Orders. It then makes two Rapier attacks or three Light Crossbow attacks, or it makes one Rapier attack and two Light Crossbow attacks.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the city watch captain can force the target to drop one weapon it is wielding or drop one item it is carrying. If the captain chooses to make the target drop an item, the item can't be wrapped around or firmly attached to the target, such as a shirt or armor. The item lands in a space of the captain's choice within 5 feet of the target.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Issue Orders
actions.description: The city watch captain shouts orders at up to two friendly creatures it can see within 30 feet of it. Each target can do one of the following as a reaction:

monster:ccdx:clacking-skeleton.languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Horrid Clacking
traits.description: If the clacking skeleton moves at least 10 feet, each beast or humanoid within 30 feet of the skeleton that can hear it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The clacking skeleton makes two attacks: one with its glaive and one with its gore or two with its shortbow.

actions.name: Glaive
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Gore
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

monster:bfrd:clay-golem.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Acid Absorption
traits.description: Whenever the golem is subjected to acid damage, it takes no damage and instead regains HP equal to the acid damage dealt.

traits.name: Construct Nature
traits.description: The golem doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Fire Weakness
traits.description: When the clay golem takes fire damage, its body temporarily hardens like baked clay. Until the end of its next turn, the golem's speed is reduced by 10 feet, it can't use Mold Hand, and its AC becomes 18.

traits.name: Golem Resilience
traits.description: The golem is immune to poison and psychic damage and to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. In addition, it is immune to exhaustion and to the charmed, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, and poisoned conditions.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.description: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The golem has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.description: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The golem makes three Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10+5) bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, as determined by Mold Hand. The target must succeed on a DC 16 STR save or suffer an effect based on the type of damage: knocked prone (bludgeoning), pushed up to 10 feet away from the golem (piercing), or its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn (slashing).

actions.name: Haste
actions.description: Until the end of its next turn, the golem magically gains a +2 bonus to its AC, has advantage on DEX saves, and can make a Slam attack as a bonus action.

bonusActions.name: Mold Hand
bonusActions.description: The clay golem molds its hand into the shape of a weapon or back into a hand. The golem's Slam attack deals bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, depending on the type of weapon chosen, until the golem uses this bonus action again. For example, a hand shaped like an axe deals slashing damage.

monster:a5e-mm:clay-guardian.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak
monster:a5e-mm:clay-guardian.damageImmunities: acid, poison, psychic; damage from nonmagical, non-adamantine weapons
monster:a5e-mm:clay-guardian.conditionImmunities: charmed, fatigue, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Acid Absorption
traits.description: When the guardian is subjected to acid damage, it instead regains hit points equal to the acid damage dealt.

traits.name: Berserk
traits.description: When the guardian starts its turn while bloodied , roll a d6. On a 6, the guardian goes berserk. While berserk, the guardian attacks the nearest creature it can see. If it can’t reach a creature, it attacks an object. The guardian stays berserk until it is destroyed or restored to full hit points.

traits.name: Bloodied Haste
traits.description: While the guardian is bloodied, its speed is doubled, it gains a +2 bonus to AC, it has advantage on Dexterity saving throws , and it can use its slam as a bonus action.

traits.name: Constructed Nature
traits.description: Guardians dont require air, sustenance, or sleep.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.description: The guardian is immune to any effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The guardian has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The guardian attacks twice with its slam.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature  it makes a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage dealt. The target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0. A greater restoration spell or similar magic removes the reduction.

monster:tob3:climbing-vine.conditionImmunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone

traits.name: Digestive Dew
traits.description: A creature that starts its turned grappled by the climbing vine takes 2 (1d4) acid.

traits.name: Flexible Form
traits.description: A climbing vine can move through a space as narrow as 6 inches wide with o squeezing.

reactions.name: Grasping Retaliation
reactions.description: When a creature hits the climbing vine with melee attack while within 5 ft. of the vine the vine can make one Dewvine attack vs. it.

monster:a5e-mm:cloaker.speed: 10 ft., Climb 5 ft., Fly 50 ft., Swim 5 ft.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: When motionless, the cloaker is indistinguishable from a black cloak or similar cloth or leather article.

traits.name: Light Sensitivity
traits.description: The cloaker has disadvantage on attack rolls and Perception checks while in bright light.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage  and the target is grappled (escape DC 15). If the cloaker has advantage against the target  the cloaker attaches to the targets head  and the target is blinded and suffocating. Until this grapple ends  the cloaker automatically hits the grappled creature with this attack. When the cloaker is dealt damage while grappling  it takes half the damage (rounded down) and the other half is dealt to the grappled target. The cloaker can have only one creature grappled at once.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage  and the creature makes a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  it is poisoned until the end of the cloakers next turn.

actions.name: Moan
actions.description: Each non-aberration creature within 60 feet that can hear its moan makes a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  it is frightened until the end of the cloakers next turn. When a creature succeeds on this saving throw  it becomes immune to the cloakers moan for 24 hours.

actions.name: Phantasms
actions.description: The cloaker magically creates flickering illusions of itself in its space. Attacks on it have disadvantage. This effect ends after 1 minute  when the cloaker enters an area of bright light  or when it successfully grapples a creature.

reactions.name: Reactive Tail
reactions.description: When hit or missed with a melee attack, the cloaker makes a tail attack against the attacker.

reactions.name: Angry Moan
reactions.description: When the cloaker takes damage, it uses Moan.

monster:bfrd:cloaker.speed: 10 ft., Climb 5 ft., Fly 40 ft., Swim 5 ft.

traits.name: Aberrant Resilience
traits.description: The cloaker is resistant to the charmed, frightened, paralyzed, and stunned conditions, and it has advantage on saves against spells or effects that would alter its form.

traits.name: Damage Transfer
traits.description: While attached to a creature, the cloaker takes only half the damage dealt to it (rounded down), and that creature takes the other half.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the cloaker remains motionless without its underside exposed, it is indistinguishable from a dark leather cloak.

traits.name: Light Sensitivity
traits.description: While in bright light, the cloaker has disadvantage on attack rolls, and its Perception is 6 when perceiving by sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The cloaker makes one Bite attack and two Tail attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 18 (4d6+4) piercing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, the cloaker attaches to it. If the cloaker has advantage on the attack roll, the cloaker attaches to the target's head, and the target is blinded and unable to breathe while the cloaker is attached. While attached, the cloaker can't make Bite attacks, and at the start of each of the cloaker's turns, the target takes 18 (4d6+4) piercing damage. The attached cloaker moves with the target whenever the target moves, requiring none of the cloaker's movement. It can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement on its turn. A creature, including the target, can take its action to detach the cloaker by succeeding on a DC 15 STR check.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8+4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Moan
actions.description: The cloaker releases a deep, thrumming moan that rattles the nerves of all who hear it. Each creature within 30 feet of the cloaker that can hear the moan and that isn't an Aberration must make a DC 15 WIS save. On a failure, a creature takes 40 (9d8) psychic damage and is frightened until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't frightened.

bonusActions.name: Cloak of Shadows
bonusActions.description: While the cloaker isn't in bright light, it pulls shadows around itself, partially obscuring its form. For 1 minute or until the cloaker is hit with an attack, the cloaker's Stealth is 20, and creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls against the cloaker.

monster:tob:clockwork-abomination.damageResistances: acid, cold, fire; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster:tob:clockwork-abomination.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Additional Legs
traits.description: Four legs allow the clockwork abomination to climb at a speed equal to its base speed and to ignore difficult terrain.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.description: The clockwork abomination is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Infernal Power Source
traits.description: When a clockwork abomination falls to 0 hp, its infernal battery explodes. Creatures within 10 feet of the clockwork abomination take 14 (4d6) fire damage, or half damage with a successful DC 14 Dexterity saving throw.

traits.name: Piston Reach
traits.description: The abomination's melee attacks have a deceptively long reach thanks to the pistons powering them.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The clockwork abomination makes one bite attack and one slam attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Breath Weapon
actions.description: The clockwork abomination's Infernal Power Source allows it to breathe fire in a 20-foot cone. Targets in this cone take 22 (4d10) fire damage, or half damage with a successful DC 14 Dexterity saving throw.

monster:tob-2023:clockwork-abomination.damageResistances: acid, cold, fire; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster:tob-2023:clockwork-abomination.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Construct Nature
traits.description: The clockwork abomination doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Explosive Infernal Power Source
traits.description: When a clockwork abomination is destroyed, its infernal battery explodes. Each creature within 10 feet of the abomination must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The explosion ignites flammable objects in the area that aren’t being worn or carried.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.description: The clockwork abomination is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The clockwork abomination has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Unstoppable
traits.description: Moving through difficult terrain doesn’t cost the clockwork abomination extra movement, and its speed can’t be reduced.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The clockwork abomination makes one Bite attack and one Slam attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath
actions.description: The clockwork abomination's infernal power source allows it to breathe fire in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monster:tob2:clockwork-archon.speed: 30 ft., Climb 15 ft., Fly 60 ft. (hover), Swim 15 ft.
monster:tob2:clockwork-archon.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone

traits.name: Armored Transport
traits.description: The clockwork archon can carry up to six Medium or eight Small creatures inside its torso. Creatures inside the archon have total cover against attacks and other effects outside the archon. The two escape hatches sit in the torso and can each be opened as a bonus action, allowing creatures in or out of the archon.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.description: The clockwork archon is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The clockwork archon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: The clockwork archon deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The clockwork archon makes two attacks with its transforming weapon.

actions.name: Transforming Weapon
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 29 (4d10 + 7) bludgeoning or slashing damage. As a bonus action, the archon can change its weapon from a sword to a hammer or vice versa, allowing it to change its damage between bludgeoning and slashing.

actions.name: Fire from Heaven
actions.description: The clockwork archon unleashes a brilliant beam in a 90-foot line that is 10-feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 58 (13d8) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monster:tob3:clockwork-armadillo.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak
monster:tob3:clockwork-armadillo.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Construct Nature
traits.description: Doesn’t require air food drink or sleep.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.description: Immune: form-altering spells/effects.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

traits.name: Overclocked
traits.description: Advantage on initiative rolls.

monster:ccdx:clockwork-assassin.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Assassinate
traits.description: During its first turn, the assassin has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. Any hit the assassin scores against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

traits.name: Explosive Core
traits.description: When the assassin is destroyed, its core explodes, projecting superheated steam and shrapnel. Each creature within 5 feet of the construct must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.description: The assassin is immune to any spell or effect, other than its disassembly trait, that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The assassin has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Psychic Susceptibility
traits.description: If the assassin takes psychic damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.description: The assassin deals an extra 10 (3d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the assassin that isn't incapacitated and the assassin doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.description: The assassin's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The clockwork assassin makes two rapier attacks.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 11 (2d10) poison damage and be poisoned for 1 minute.

actions.name: Disassembly
actions.description: The assassin breaks its body down into a snakelike, segmented cylinder, which allows it to move through a space as narrow as 6 inches wide. It can reassemble itself into its true form by using this action again. While disassembled into its snake form, the assassin can't attack and attack rolls against it have advantage.

monster:tob:clockwork-beetle.speed: 30 ft., Climb 15 ft., Fly 50 ft., Swim 15 ft.
monster:tob:clockwork-beetle.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.description: The clockwork beetle is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The clockwork beetle has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) poison damage, or one-half poison damage with a successful DC 10 Constitution saving throw.

monster:tob-2023:clockwork-beetle.speed: 50 ft., Climb 25 ft., Fly 30 ft., Swim 25 ft.
monster:tob-2023:clockwork-beetle.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak
monster:tob-2023:clockwork-beetle.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Construct Nature
traits.description: The clockwork beetle doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.description: The clockwork beetle is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Limited Telepathy
traits.description: The clockwork beetle can magically transmit simple messages and images to its owner, provided the owner is within 100 feet of it.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The clockwork beetle has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw, taking 5 (2d4) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monster:tob:clockwork-beetle-swarm.speed: 30 ft., Climb 15 ft., Fly 50 ft., Swim 15 ft.
monster:tob:clockwork-beetle-swarm.conditionImmunities: charmed, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, stunned

traits.name: Swarm
traits.description: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny construct. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

actions.name: Bites
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 0 ft., up to 4 creatures in the swarm's space. Hit: 17 (5d6) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

monster:tob-2023:clockwork-beetle-swarm.speed: 50 ft., Climb 25 ft., Fly 30 ft., Swim 25 ft.
monster:tob-2023:clockwork-beetle-swarm.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned

traits.name: Construct Nature
traits.description: The swarm doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The swarm has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.description: The swarm can occupy another creature’s space and vice versa, and it can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny Construct. The swarm can’t regain hp or gain temporary hp.

actions.name: Bites
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 18 (4d8) piercing damage, or 9 (2d8) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hp or fewer, plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

monster:tob3:clockwork-conductor.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak
monster:tob3:clockwork-conductor.conditionImmunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Construct Nature
traits.description: Doesn’t require air food drink or sleep.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.description: Immune: form-altering spells/effects.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

- 1/Day Each: Control Weather, Gaseous Form

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The giant attacks twice with its glaive.

actions.name: Glaive
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (3d10 + 8) slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature  it makes a DC 20 Strength saving throw. On a failure  it is pushed up to 10 feet away from the giant and knocked prone.

actions.name: Rock
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 39 (9d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature  it makes a DC 20 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure.

actions.name: Fog Cloud
actions.description: (1st-Level; V, S, Concentration) The giant creates a 20-foot-radius  heavily obscured sphere of fog centered on a point it can see within 120 feet. The fog spreads around corners and can be dispersed by a moderate wind (at least 10 miles per hour). It lasts for 1 hour.

actions.name: Arc Lightning
actions.description: Up to three creatures within 60 feet that the giant can see make DC 15 Dexterity saving throws  taking 42 (12d6) lightning damage on a failure or half damage on a success.

actions.name: Blinking Blades
actions.description: The giant magically teleports multiple times within a few seconds. The giant may make one glaive attack against each creature of its choice within 30 feet  up to a maximum of 6 attacks.

actions.name: Reverse Gravity
actions.description: Each creature of the giants choice within 30 feet is magically hurled 60 feet in the air. If a creature hits an obstacle  it takes 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage. The creatures then fall  taking falling damage as normal.

actions.name: Silver Tongue
actions.description: One creature that can hear the giant within 30 feet makes a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  it is magically charmed by the giant for 1 hour. This effect ends if the giant or its allies harm the creature.

bonusActions.name: Gust
bonusActions.description: One creature within 10 feet makes a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failure, it is pushed up to 30 feet away from the giant.

bonusActions.name: Misty Step
bonusActions.description: (2nd-Level; V) The giant teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet. The giant can't cast this spell and a 1st-level or higher spell on the same turn.

traits.name: Shoving Charge
traits.description: If it moves at least 20' straight toward a target and then hits it with Headbutt attack on the same turn that target must make DC 13 Str save or be pushed up to 10 ft. away from the cloudhoof. If a creature fails this save by 5 or more it is pushed up to 15 ft..

traits.name: Sure-Hooved
traits.description: Has advantage on Str and Dex checks and saves made vs. effects that would knock it prone. In addition it has advantage on Str (Athletics) checks to climb rocky surfaces and Dex (Acrobatics) checks to maintain its balance on rocky surfaces.

traits.name: Clurichaun's Luck
traits.description: Clurichauns add both their Dexterity and Charisma modifiers to their Armor Class.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description:
the clurichaun's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). The clurichaun can cast the following spells, requiring only alcohol as a component.

at will: friends, mending, minor illusion, purify food and drink, vicious mockery

1/day each: blur, calm emotions, heroism, sleep, suggestion

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The clurichaun has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 2 (1 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Improvised Weapon
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one creature. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, depending on weapon.

traits.name: Clurichaun’s Luck
traits.description: While the clurichaun is conscious and wearing no armor and wielding no shield, it adds its Charisma modifier to its AC (included above).

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The clurichaun has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Improvised Weapon
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, depending on the weapon.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Bawdy Remark
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, range 30 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be incapacitated until the end of its next turn as it doubles over in laughter or freezes up in embarrassment (the target's choice).

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The clurichaun casts one of the following spells, requiring alcohol as the only material component and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

- At Will: mending, purify food and drink
- 1/Day Each: blur, heroism, suggestion

traits.name: Glowing Organs
traits.description: While underwater its internal organs glow an eerie pale blue shedding dim light in a 10 ft. radius.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: While out of water can hold its breath for 30 min.

traits.name: Water Breathing
traits.description: Can breathe only underwater.

monster:tob:cobbleswarm.conditionImmunities: charmed, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, prone, stunned

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the swarm remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from normal stones.

traits.name: Shift and Tumble
traits.description: As a bonus action, the swarm can push a prone creature whose space it occupies 5 feet.

traits.name: Shifting Floor
traits.description: Whenever the swarm moves into a creature's space or starts its turn in another creature's space, that other creature must make a successful DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone. A prone creature must make a successful DC 13 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check to stand up in a space occupied by the swarm.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.description: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny stone. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

actions.name: Stings
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 10 (4d4) piercing damage, or 5 (2d4) piercing damage if the swarm has half its hit points or fewer.
